① 今日必做：優先處理 CVE-2026-54349（Chartbrew，CVSS 9.8，SQL 注入，命中 data 核心包）同 CVE-2026-123836（JetBrains Datalore，CVSS 8.8，協作者可攞走 owner 嘅 SSH 私鑰，命中 web 核心包），即刻核對版本並升級至修復版本。
② 趨勢方面：py 生態連續出現代碼執行／命令注入類漏洞（h5io、Airflow、AgentScope），Linux kernel 有 DSA 安全更新並被 CISA 加入已知被利用目錄，另有 OpenSSH 配 musl libc 嘅密碼認證繞過，集中喺核心基礎設施層。
③ 風險提示：SSH 私鑰同認證繞過類漏洞一旦被利用可直接接管主機，核實版本前切勿假設現有部署安全。

sideline.title: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026
sideline.summary: An examination of global Internet disruptions observed by Cloudflare Radar during the third quarter of 2026. This review analyzes how power failures, natural disasters, and government shutdowns impacted network connectivity and traffic.

sideline.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
sideline.summary: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.

sideline.title: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
sideline.summary: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.
